content.text:
The app failed to start because Spring Data didn't register my repositories, which I had declared as nested interfaces inside a `Repositories` class. The app container log showed `No qualifying bean of type 'Repositories$UserRepository'`.

**Fix:** I deleted `domain/Repositories.java` and made `UserRepository`, `HoldingRepository` and `TradeRepository` top-level interfaces in `domain/`. I also removed the now-unused import from `FinanceService.java`.

**Verification:** `docker compose run --rm --no-deps app mvn -q -B package -DskipTests` compiles cleanly. I did not start the app, so the startup fix is untested. The earlier log did show Hibernate creating the schema without errors before the context failed, so the datasource and entities look fine.

Please restart the stack to confirm the app comes up.
